'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Caleb Foth DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Caleb Foth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck Walters :-). L4 MPG marked (LS). L40 Hoth Blockade (V). Shield11 scribbled → Firepower (V) from Additional. See notes/batch8_notes.py.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
